title: Driver fun
summary: A driver on a shader value: the cables get a rope material (a wave texture through a mapping node), and the mapping's X location is driven by leg one's two bones (their local Z rotation): -leg + (-knee / 10), so the rope's texture slides as if pulled when the leg moves. (The tutor then removes it, since all cables share the material; it is kept here as the example.)
expected_result: The phage's cables now look like twisted rope.

steps.note: the cable material: a wave texture (placed with a mapping node) as colour -- a twisted rope
a driver on the mapping's X location: both leg-one bones' local Z rotation; when the leg lifts the rope is pulled in: -leg plus a tenth of -knee
